_comment: Settings of the running experiment (owner's choices, 12-13 Nov 2026): aggressive profile. No forward test, more strategies, 5% equity risk per trade, validated strategies up to 25% of equity per position, EXPLORATION of 6 unvalidated high-frequency crypto strategies at up to 15% per position with a 150 EUR loss budget. No leverage; new trades still pause at -10% in a day or -20% from the peak.
